properties.label: 753 BC
properties.note: Symbolic: a circle of 1.5 km radius around the Pleiades location of Rome. The early city is not mapped.

properties.label: 264 BC
properties.note: Built from modern Italian provinces (Natural Earth admin-1), so the outline is coarse and follows modern boundaries.

properties.label: 133 BC
properties.note: Provinces held at the date (AD 200 AWMC borders), clipped to the AWMC extent for 60 BC. Approximate; Republican control inland was patchy.

properties.label: 44 BC
properties.note: Provinces held at the date (AD 200 AWMC borders); provinces older than 60 BC are clipped to the AWMC extent for 60 BC. Client kingdoms are not counted.

properties.label: AD 14
properties.note: Provinces held at the death of Augustus (AD 200 AWMC borders). Client kingdoms are not counted.

properties.label: AD 117
properties.note: AWMC extent for AD 117 (Barrington Atlas basis), including Trajan's short-lived provinces of Armenia, Mesopotamia and Assyria.

properties.label: AD 211
properties.note: AWMC extent for AD 200 stands in for AD 211 (no change of note between them).

properties.label: AD 395
properties.note: Provinces held at the date (AD 200 AWMC borders), split into East and West by province. Dacia and the lands beyond the Rhine were already gone.

properties.label: AD 395
properties.note: Provinces held at the date (AD 200 AWMC borders), split into East and West by province. Dacia and the lands beyond the Rhine were already gone.

properties.label: AD 395
properties.note: Provinces held at the date (AD 200 AWMC borders), split into East and West by province. Dacia and the lands beyond the Rhine were already gone.

properties.label: AD 476
properties.note: The Eastern empire only (the provinces held in the East at 395; the Danube frontier was already under pressure).

properties.label: AD 476
properties.note: The Eastern empire only (the provinces held in the East at 395; the Danube frontier was already under pressure).

properties.label: AD 565
properties.note: The East plus Justinian's reconquests (the `west` part). Reconquered Spain and Mauretania are clipped to the coastal areas actually held.

properties.label: AD 565
properties.note: The East plus Justinian's reconquests (the `west` part). Reconquered Spain and Mauretania are clipped to the coastal areas actually held.

properties.label: AD 565

properties.label: AD 1000
properties.note: Built from modern administrative units (Natural Earth admin-1) chosen to match the Byzantine themes; coarse, and Bulgaria was only taken in 1018.

properties.label: AD 1180
properties.note: Built from modern administrative units (Natural Earth admin-1); whole units overshoot into contested Anatolia and the western Balkans.

properties.label: AD 1453
properties.note: Constantinople and the Morea only, from modern administrative units clipped to the city and the Peloponnese.
